Trump rejects AI slowdown, warns of China competition

Former US President Donald Trump has rejected calls from tech executives to slow down artificial intelligence (AI) development, stating that whoever leads in AI will "win." He expressed concerns about China's advancements in the field. Trump reportedly suggested that an agreement with China to pause AI development could lead to a Nobel Peace Prize for both him and Chinese President Xi Jinping. However, he also warned that the US must not let China get ahead in AI, indicating a dual approach of potential cooperation and competition.
